reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with the care and communication we received from this veterinary hospital.

I brought my cat in twice because his symptoms were continuing and getting worse. Despite explaining that the prescribed treatment was not working, I was repeatedly told to continue doing the same thing, without a treatment plan that seemed to address his worsening condition.

The situation became even more frustrating after the visits. I had to repeatedly follow up with the hospital to get the medication that had been prescribed. It took almost two weeks for the prescription to finally be sent to the pharmacy. To make matters worse, the medication was apparently shipped to our address rather than being arranged for pickup, and it has now been lost.

Meanwhile, my cat has continued experiencing worsening symptoms without the medication he was supposed to receive. When I contacted the hospital about the situation, I was told they were experiencing a shortage of veterinarians.

I understand that veterinary hospitals can be busy and that staffing challenges happen. However, when an animal’s condition is getting worse, timely communication, follow-through, and appropriate care are extremely important. Having to repeatedly chase a veterinary team for a prescribed medication, only for it to be delayed and ultimately lost, is unacceptable and has added unnecessary stress to an already worrying situation.

I expected better communication, accountability, and urgency when it came to my cat’s health. Based on this experience, I am very dissatisfied with the service and would have difficulty trusting this hospital with my pet’s ongoing care again.
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!

Impressively competent care for my Greyhounds at 2nd St AH.  Early on, they saved the life of one of my dogs with an emergency operation.  What more can I say?

Years later, the staff at 2nd St AH continues to impress me with their observations and resulting care.  Dr. Hurcombe is a gem.  Highly recommended.
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!

Good spot, took my clown loach fish. . Had a swimming issues cant keep balance. Dr.  was extremely helpful
Took the time to check all vitals ,and administerd antibiotics.

My 11-year old axolotl was having gastrointestinal issues and Dr. Meade was absolutely amazing to work with in getting them resolved. Very sweet and detailed in care instructions and answers to any questions. Additionally the post appointment check in’s to monitor progress before a follow up were greatly appreciated and allowed for help with any questions that arose during the treatment process.

I took my dog here for years, but since the change in ownership it’s been a revolving door of vets with no consistency. This didn’t bother me when he was coming in for routine visits, but in an emergency in June the new vet told me blatantly wrong information and referred me to the ER. They never sent the xray (which they charged $475+ for and never showed me) to the ER and prolonged my dog’s discomfort. When I emailed about this issue, they never replied.
Great staff, so friendly and always helpful. Very patient with my pup who’s scared of everything and our spicy kitties!

I would highly recommend 2nd Street to any pet parents. From the very beginning just setting up appointment to end of visit it was a place where not only are they very compassionate very helpful and understanding. Full disclosure about everything. And if it can't be done there suggests reasonable places.The receptionist, the Technician and Vet were all super nice. And their prices are reasonable as well
Dr. Hurcombe and Jordan made a sedated visit with my reactive German Shepherd much less stressful for both my dog and me. I really appreciated their patience and care throughout the visit.
Highly recommend! Above and beyond!

please remove that annoying AI - it is beyond frustrating trying to argue with a machine that cuts you off mid sentence and has no idea what the hell is going on…. + the fake bg noise and keyboard typing noise is just silly… Calling You guys is completely pointless
cant even leave a message with that dumb receptionist as it cuts you off mid sentence and conversation is not fluid AT ALL

Dr's and staff was very knowledgeable and professional they really care about your pets when they find the diagnosis they explain in detail before they continue to the next step the office,waiting area and the rooms where very clean and organized the bathrooms where very clean  and organized the wait time to be seen was reasonable
Very friendly & attentive staff every time we go and they were a huge help in preventing a major surgery for our pup!
This place is so awesome !!! They saved my chiweenie ( via surgery) from a torturuous condition. Everyone is so kind and professional. Thankyou Dr Hurcombe!  They absolutely get five stars.

The team at 2nd Street Animal Hospital is compassionate, professional, and attentive, which is why I always trust Dr. Shim with the care and wellness of my cats. She takes the time to explain everything and truly cares about my cats.
I’m so grateful to have found such a reliable and caring veterinary team!
Friendly, caring and always put the pets and people first! This is the vet for my puppy and they are incredible!
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!

🐰 they are amazing.  The staff are very welcoming and obviously LOVE their jobs.  The vet explained everything I needed to know. Took her time making sure i understood everything.  I will keep returning to them.!!!

Why 3 stars?. Bc they use AI to answer their phones. I hung up. A real person called back. Which was awesome. Small businesses using AI  IRKS my soul. Ai is already killing jobs.

Besides that they are great.

🐶Edit. Since the review the AI has been removed .

An exceptional establishment!! We took our one year old here due to her ingesting some string. The staff was great with excellent communication and very good/safe Covid-19 procedures. The vet was very attentive to our cat and was extremely helpful/friendly while talking to us over the phone regarding her condition. Most definitely recommend this vet!

Update 3/31/26. For some reason it says I edited this a month ago? I did not.  My previous update was that the vet taking care of our cat had an attitude before surgery and when I was asking questions. My cat ended up having an infection at the incision site so we needed an emergency surgery done at a big vet in southern NJ. No issues after that
Wonderful, knowledgeable service

I came in with my Indian Ringneck for an emergency visit after a horrible accident with many injuries and negative symptoms. My bird and I were both having the absolute worst few days of our lives but Dr. Meade sat with us for over an hour. She listened to every single detailed concern I had, examined my bird thoroughly, answered all of my many questions, and gave so much advice on how to best care for my bird going forward. Dr. Meade kept in close contact with me over the next month and a half while I gave updates and asked new questions, until we came in for a follow up appointment to recheck everything. My bird is now doing much much better and he is definitely on the path to a full recovery, thanks to Dr. Meade and 2nd Street Vet! The technician Addi was super kind and helpful with my bird too! They also had a cute Valentine’s Day setup for photos in their office on our second visit :)

2nd Street Animal Hospital is wonderful. Dr. Sharonda and the staff are top tier. They really just want the best for all animals. They supported me and helped come up with solutions for my budget and my pets needs. The hospital is adorable and makes you feel at home. Also, before or after your visit, ask for Leroy Brown.. you won’t regret it☺️

Love this place! Took my 14 year old Labrador who suffers from arthritis and they fixed her right up and helped my girl to feel so much better. We are so grateful for the 2nd Street Animal hospital team for their love, support and hugs for our four legged family member 🩵 …

Horrible hospital.  Do NOT bring your animal there.  Brought in leopard gecko there to get checked out.  They said she was fine.  Pumped her with a couple of shots.  Died 2 days later.  Charged an arm and a leg.  Only spoke to us for 20 min.

Dr. Meade, Addi and Shyheem were all incredible with my rabbits. I have just moved states and was very nervous to try a new exotics vet, but I seem to have found a winner on the first try!

Dr. Meade took care to make each of my rabbits feel comfortable and safe. She took the time to explain what she was doing, things to look for and be aware of for the future. I learned a lot and feel relief finding a new vet I can trust. She was patient answering questions and Addi even sent a follow up email on a tool I was recommended to buy.

Addi and Shyheem took photos of the buns for their first vet visit and made the whole visit feel so warm and friendly! I love the genuine enthusiasm and interest for animal care that I felt from everyone!

I had a great time meeting everyone and would definitely recommend them as an exotics vet. I will note that they are pricy, but most exotic vets are.

The office itself is very nice and has a cute waiting area with tea and coffee.
Five stars cause the pet pictures are cute
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!
Very welcoming and gentle with our friends

My dog threw up after her first vaccine. We called the clinic to talk to her vet, but they just told us to go to the emergency room. For her second visit, she needed two vaccines. They recommended giving one that day and the other the next day. She got the first vaccine, but when we returned for the second one, they injected the same vaccine again and then told us that we were mistaken. Overall, it was not a good experience with this center.
The staff at 2nd street are always so nice, attentive, and informative. It's obvious how much they truly care about the pets. We really appreciate that! :)

I brought my rat Spider here because I was concerned he had cancer. The technicians and front desk staff were all lovely and super friendly.

One thing I really like is that they let me come back with him as the previous two vets I have been to either didn't allow this or charged extra for you to accompany :/

Spider's doctor was great. She explained everything to me and why she had the conclusions she did which I appreciated a lot. Luckily, Spider doesn't have cancer! We kept options open for his future treatment and I didn't feel pressured at all.

Very pleased with my visit, thanks!
First time since moving to Philly and the service was beyond excellent. Dr Meade was very knowledgeable and attentive about our pet bunny's needs.

We love love love Dr Meade. We saw her years ago in NJ and are so happy she is here now. We have been to so many different vets after 15 years of having piggies. She is the best one, she is very smart and cares about the animals so much. She knows all the latest treatments and medicines and tries to keep your price affordable. We were so sad when she left the other folic we were going to, but now that she is here we are jumping for joy. She spends a lot of time explaining and doesn’t move if you ask a million questions. We love her!

Coming from a household with an exotic pet, I’ve had multiple 5-star experiences at 2nd Street Animal Hospital over the last year and a half. The following review is about my latest visit there (third overall).

My pet rabbit had an unexpected scare a few nights ago. It was a false alarm (thankfully), but I still had some lingering questions about his overall health. So, I went on 2nd Street Animal Hospital’s website, filled out a quick form, and scheduled an appointment for the next day. It was very easy to set up.

Huge shoutout to Dr. Meade, Francis, & Jeffrey for all the insight they shared during that appointment. Even though I had a laundry list of questions, they took the time to thoroughly and meaningfully answer everything I asked them. Unsurprisingly, they also took excellent care of my rabbit; Thanks to Dr. Meade & Francis’ magic, he was unexpectedly Zen throughout his entire checkup and nail trimming session.

5/5 stars.

Second Street Animal Hospital is absolutely phenomenal! The staff is top-notch 🥇and there’s been an incredible positive shift in the atmosphere lately. They handle everything! Routine check-ups to complex surgeries. Dr. Hurcombe’s attentive touch is making waves, and you can feel the love and dedication the moment you walk in. Highly recommend them for all your furry friends in Philly! They truly go above and beyond!

Friendly, knowledgeable staff  made our visit pleasant and easy for our easily distracted dog. Loving hands, confident doctors, and capable vet techs make this the right place to bring our furry family member.

This vet is amazing. I took my leopard gecko for a visit to assess her hunger strike and the tech was so kind and gentle when helping the doctor do a check up on her. The doctor was informative and gentle and made me calmer while handling my fidgety gecko (she’s is a nervous nelly and a runner). They also talked you through pricing making sure you know what you’re paying for as well as setting up limits on how much you are able to afford. Will be going back here if any of my animals needs a visit
Shame on this Hospital. I was in a time of crisis and was completely dismissed after taking my pet there for 6+ years. I was treated wrong. I will not be recommending to anyone. 👎 …

Very glad to have found this place. It has amazing friendly staff that are very welcoming. Very happy taking my animals there and got great care from Dr. Meade. Did not feel rushed through they took the time to explain everything and gave my dog the best care.

I rarely write reviews for businesses, but when looking for a new vet, the reviews helped me choose 2nd st animal hospital. Dr. Bender is extremely knowledgeable about exotics, and was especially helpful and caring when I brought my beardie in for checkups. The empathy and compassion they showed when I had to put down my beardie was beyond appreciated. The entire team here is so kind, friendly, caring, and welcoming. I appreciate everything they do and highly recommend using this clinic to care for all your pet’s needs!
Thank you so so much for helping my Sage! 2nd street have been wonderful and also handled the ugly crying of a stressed out pet mom with ease.

The MOST pleasant staff I've ever encountered in an animal hospital. YOU DONT GET THAT OFTEN ANYMORE! Responsive, thorough, compassionate and extremely upfront with costs. No surprises! Need more people like this in veterinary medicine. Love this place!

I only am giving one star because I want people to see this! Please Do Not get care for your pet here! Everyone should be recording every interaction they have with this clinic. My pet died going here. We requested for my dog to have scans after having a cough. We pressured for a scan to be done of our dogs throat and chest and was turned down. They insisted they were trying to save us money,however we were insisted a scan, and said money is not an issue for us after all we have CareCredit. She denied the scan, prescribed us medications, and said come back in a month! Over the next two weeks he struggled with the medication feeling more sedated then anything. He proceeded to vomit  and began to breathe unusually. We rushed him to the ER, he had scan after scan and it turned out to be a severe case of pneumonia. $2000 later, We left the ER with most medications except for the antibiotic, he was supposed to pick up from his primary vet. He would have to take an antibiotic that would be strong and last for 7 days. I went back giving them a second chance to 2nd street and they gave me and antibiotic for 21 days, not 7. They said the reason behind this is that they didn't have the specific 7day antibiotic stocked in their pharmacy  however they have an antibiotic for 21 days and that my dog should be okay with the 21day antibiotic.I voiced my concerns but was dismissed.A week passed and my dog was suffering to breathe.  I rushed him back to the ER were he would later pass away. Another $2000 and my pet was dead. I called, left messages that we were at the ER and got no response until the next day, when I voiced all my concerns and asked for some accountability and to possibly get reimbursed for their mistakes. They didn't even acknowledge any of it. The ER doctor even asked "why for such a sickly dog would you not have done atleast 1 scan, and giving the sickly dog with severe pneumonia a 21day antibiotic verses a 7day antibiotic?" They responded with we like to tapper our dogs down from the antibiotic. The ER vet was stunned because they knew that wasn't true for a dog suffering severely. She then goes on to say I refused  scans to be done at the beginning and it's the vets word verses our word(pet owner). In such if you don't have recorded proof during your first visit, there's basically nothing they can do. Well, I have my visit recording and phone recordings thus proving thier negligence. My recommendation is to stay away from these clinics that just treat you and your pet as a number. Stay away from here but if you must backup and record everything appointments and phone conversations, because they are only looking out for themselves not in the interest of your pet!
Friendly visit for my new fur baby

The worst vet I’ve ever been to. The vet themselves is never the same person so pets can’t build a relationship and the vet has no history outside of what a past vet has written in their notes. Even worse, competence between vets varies immensely. One will give every bit of information and options, follow up with test results promptly and answer all questions, while others will do the exact opposite and never even write a summary or include test results so they have to be redone (we’re talking over $500 worth of testing down the drain because the previous vet literally wrote nothing), to others who will upsell you on random things that your pet doesn’t need. I don’t mean extra blood work or treatments or vaccines, I mean hard-selling random new pharmaceuticals for problems my pet has never had, shows no signs of currently having and is at absolute zero risk for given our lifestyle (which they even admitted to).

When I finally transferred to a different veterinary office after two years of this, the office (friendly but deeply inept) did not follow up with the new one and didn’t send the basic information over even after we/they made numerous phone calls and follow ups. And then the information was incomplete. This also happened during an emergency visit to VEG. They gave them wrong information that VEG immediately recognized as wrong and then had trouble getting the correct information. They eventually did but it took hours, and this was during business hours so there was no excuse. Just overall incompetence and a horrible experience that put my pet in danger during a critical moment.
We are always thrilled to see happy clients! If there is anything else we can do for you, please reach out to us directly. See you soon!
The front desk & vet tech were outstanding as usual. The Doctor brought up things I had been meaning to ask for a long time & alleviated concerns.

There are no words big enough to hold the amount of gratitude I have for the team at 2nd Street Animal Hospital, but I’ll try my best.

Last week, I had to do one of the hardest things I’ve ever done in my life: say goodbye to my beloved dog, Trixie. She wasn’t just a pet. She was my shadow, my emotional anchor, my sunshine through years of personal storms. For more than a decade, she stood by me as I navigated the toughest parts of life, always offering comfort without needing to speak a word.

In her final days, Trixie was struggling. She was confused, losing weight, and clearly in pain. As much as I wanted to hold on forever, I knew she deserved peace. Still, making that decision was terrifying. But everything changed when I walked into 2nd Street Animal Hospital.

From the moment we arrived, the staff showed us nothing but compassion, dignity, and grace. They did not rush us. They did not treat this like just another procedure. They allowed us time real, and meaningful time to sit with her, talk to her, hold her, and simply be with her as she transitioned beyond this realm.

When the moment came, I held her face in my hands, smiled through the tears, and sang “You Are My Sunshine” to her. I wanted her to hear love as she slipped away. I wanted her to feel safe and to know she was surrounded by warmth and care. Because of the patience and empathy from the team at 2nd Street Animal Hospital, I was able to give her that parting gift. They gave us space to grieve without pressure, to love without interruption, and to say goodbye in the gentlest way possible.

Trixie left this world peacefully. And I will never forget the kindness that made that possible.

Thank you, 2nd Street, for your empathy, your professionalism, and your humanity. You helped me honor someone who gave me everything. That means more than you will ever know

I've been bringing my bearded dragon here for a while now & I love it here! Their exotics vet is very kind & skilled, & the whole staff crew is incredibly kind & helpful. They treat all patients with so much care, & they always go above & beyond. I only trust this facility with my dragon! I feel as though she's truly cared for here.
They ca e and cost us fair

This place needs to be avoided at all costs. Been going here for a few years. I have an older cat with thyroid issues and scheduled for a yearly check-up and wanted senior blood work for her. Was quoted over $500 for just the blood work. I immediately called a different vet, confirmed their cost is $250, and left with my cat. Went back through my invoices, and just last year, they charged me $275 for the bloodwork. (See my bad photo for proof) If you've been going here, it's time to find a new vet. Absolutely unbelievable price gouging

I am only giving this place two stars instead of one because they were initially SO great with my cats from daily appointments to the day we had to put my first critter down. HOWEVER, we had to stop going there because the quality of care declined significantly. They constantly pressured us to pay for more expensive and unnecessary tests for our cat, despite our cat’s very advanced age and his various incurable and comorbid disorders. They guilted us when we told them that we were more focused on palliative care than curative measures for our 17 year old cat. What’s worse,  when my cat was very sick and looked to be in decline, I asked the vet what she would do if she were in my shoes and she said “I can’t tell you what to do, ma’am.” This vet used to be great but now they prioritize profit over quality of life. Don’t bother with this place.
We are always thrilled to see happy clients! If there is anything else we can do for you, please reach out to us directly. See you soon!
Not a good place to take your pet. You get the run around with appt.  And diagnosis. They are always short veterinarians.

Everyone was super great and treated our cat and dog with care. Unfortunately we realized we were definitely overpaying… by a lot… when comparing services with other local vets for the same level of care.

2 years ago 2nd St AH saved this little girl's life. She had a prolapse while laying eggs [on a Saturday morning], and not many vets see exotics and even less do it on weekends. After a quick internet search and a call down there, we drove an hour to 2nd St. and they fixed her up! The liklihood of it happening again was real, but she's had 3 clutches of eggs since (although we don't breed her or keep any) this little friendly girl continues to do great! Thank you to the entire team at 2ndSt Animal Hospital - she's here today because of you guys!

Highly recommend, and much love!

First visit today. EVERY person who works there is amazing. My veterinarian was so knowledgeable and kind with my exotic pet. Beautiful and clean AF. I only wish I lived closer so they could be his primary. I still may switch over anyway. Thank you so much.
We are always thrilled to see happy clients! If there is anything else we can do for you, please reach out to us directly. See you soon!

We sadly lost our beloved Shyla, and they treated her like a princess. The items we received in our cremation package were so overwhelming and tearful. They did an awesome job, and we highly recommend 2nd St Animal Hospital. They are compassionate and professional. They really understand the loss of a family member.

Everyone at this practice is amazing and very kind. I appreciate how wonderful everyone was when I visited the practice.
Thank you to the doctors for being welcoming and thank you to the nurses for their patience.
I highly recommend this practice based on everyone’s competence and positive demeanor.
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!

I cannot recommend Dr. Bender enough! As a proud parrot parent, I was searching for a vet who truly understands the unique needs of birds, and I found just that here. The whole staff is incredibly knowledgeable and compassionate, always taking the time to answer my questions and address my concerns about Albert's health.
During our visits, Dr. Bender has shown exceptional expertise in diagnosing and treating Albert, ensuring he receives the best care possible. The clinic is clean, welcoming, and equipped with everything needed for top quality. I appreciate how they treat pets like family, making each visit a positive experience.
Thanks to their dedicated care, Albert is thriving and happy! If you're looking for a vet who genuinely cares about birds and other exotic pets, look no further than Dr. Bender. Thank you for all that you do!

I’ve been bringing my exotic pets (including ferrets and a snake) to Dr. Bender for a while, and I’ve always had a positive experience. She’s responsive and takes the time to answer any questions I have, whether it’s about my diet or care. Dr. Bender is knowledgeable about exotics and clearly has a good understanding of their needs. She is kind with my pets, which I really appreciate. If you’re looking for a vet with experience in caring for exotics, I’d recommend her.

Kind staff, very knowledgeable and helpful Veterinary care. Thoroughly made sure
I understood how to administer my dogs medication and took time to show me how to more easily do it. That was very cool & kind.

Dr. Bender is everything you'd want in an exotic animal veterinarian. You can tell she loves what she does because she's extremely compassionate with clients and always ready to answer questions! Highly recommend for all your bird, bunny, ferret, or other animal care!
They are the best. I have been coming here for 4 years and each time has been amazing.

My rabbit had her spay surgery at 2nd Street and I am so impressed! Dr. Bender, the exotics vet, is very knowledgeable and answered all of my questions before and after the surgery. She clearly knows a lot about exotic pets and explained everything in a way that was easy to understand. The techs were so friendly and welcoming. They made me feel comfortable through the whole process. The hospital itself was also very nice and modern. My baby girl is doing great after surgery and she will definitely be going back for all of her regular bunny check-ups, along with my parrot and gecko!

I've been going to Dr. Mike Weiss for all of my avian care for over 20 years and in my opinion he's the best...very honest and up front! The staff at 2nd Street Animal Hospital is also very accommodating (i.e. arranging an immediate appt when they were all booked), very caring and always eager to help...especially since I was making an hour and a half trip from the Jersey Shore! Highly trust everyone here for any/all animal needs!))

To be honest, I’ve been coming here for five years, and I will never be returning again. Since the change in ownership/management, there has been a lack of care and consideration. The vet herself was cold and sterile, No care or consideration for the news that she gave us. No empathy.  During my last appointment I had rush my cat to the emergency vet and while trying to pay the person held up my payment, knowing that my cat needed to go to the emergency vet, she was giving out treats to dogs and not at all concerned or trying to support the situation and then she told me to “have Great day” as I was visibly upset, with tears streaming down my face, thinking I was going to lose my cat. And if she didn’t know… well they should definitely consider a better communication system because it was completely unacceptable and inappropriate… Things have been going downhill since the management changed I would definitely consider going else where, the lack of empathy is evident in most staff.
This place went above and beyond for the care of my ferret.  The staff is great and I couldn't ask for a better place for my ferrets care.  Thank you so much.

Front desk is very rude, the last two times I have come they weren’t open as indicated, they be inside and don’t open up on time and have the nerve to catch a attitude when you knock on the door or press the buzzer. …

We brought our rabbit here when it stopped eating. Dr Bender was amazing! She took time to answer our questions and kept in touch throughout the whole process. The techs and staff were also wonderful. I would give 10 stars if I could!
Your feedback made our day - we are so glad we exceeded your expectations! If you need anything else, don't hesitate to reach out.
The team here is incredibly empathetic and caring. The staff was upfront and honest throughout the visit, and they took excellent care of us. Highly recommend!

I have had nothing but wonderful experiences with Dr. Bender. She answers my questions with compassion and is always willing to go into as much detail as I ask for regarding treatment approaches and potential outcomes for my pets. It is …

We have been taking our VERY anxious dog here for 2 years and they are so accommodating and helpful every time! They try to build trust with our dog, and do things on his terms. We get amazing service every time we come and never feel shamed for having the loudest dog in the city!
We are always thrilled to see happy clients! If there is anything else we can do for you, please reach out to us directly. See you soon!
